question: Can you give me an overview of our website traffic for December 2020? I'm particularly interested in the channel with the fourth highest number of sessions.
sql:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    ep.value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    traffic_source.medium,
    traffic_source.source,
    traffic_source.name AS campaign_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
       UNNEST(event_params) AS ep
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND ep.key = 'ga_session_id'
  GROUP BY ga_session_id, traffic_source.medium, traffic_source.source, traffic_source.name
),
session_channels AS (
  SELECT 
    ga_session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, 'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
      WHEN (
        (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart'))
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$')
      ) AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
      ) AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*(cp|ppc|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN (
        REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$')
      ) AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
      ) AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*(cp|ppc|retargeting|paid).*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN (
        (LOWER(source) IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart'))
        OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(campaign_name, r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$')
      ) THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN (
        REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(source), r'^(.*(badoo|facebook|fb|instagram|linkedin|pinterest|tiktok|twitter|whatsapp).*)$')
      ) OR (medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media')) THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'youtube', 'vimeo', 'twitch')
      ) OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*video.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('baidu', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'google', 'yahoo', 'yandex')
      ) OR (medium = 'organic') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN (
        LOWER(source) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')
      ) OR (LOWER(medium) IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'e mail')) THEN 'Email'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN LOWER(medium) = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN (source = 'sms' OR LOWER(medium) = 'sms') THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN (medium LIKE '%push' OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*mobile.*') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'.*notification.*')) THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT channel, COUNT(DISTINCT ga_session_id) AS sessions
FROM session_channels
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY sessions DESC
LIMIT 10
